name: Mend: Purge
description: Nanites scrub poison from your blood.  Requires a cyber brain.

name: Shell: Reactive Shell
description: A hard reactive skin for fifteen seconds.  Requires a cyber brain.

name: Reflex: Afterimage
description: Your outline lags behind your body for twenty seconds, spoiling aim.  Requires a cyber brain.

name: Strike: Lock-On
description: Nanites steady your hands and tighten your shots for a minute.  Requires a cyber brain.

name: Strike: Shock Field
description: A burst of current in a small radius around you.  Requires a cyber brain.

name: Ghost: Thermal Cloak
description: Bends light and heat around you for thirty seconds.  Requires a cyber brain.

name: Ghost: Noise Dampener
description: Your steps and shots make far less noise for a minute.  Requires a cyber brain.

name: Sense: Pulse Scan
description: A wide scan reveals the surrounding blocks on your map.  Requires a cyber brain.

name: Sense: Night Eye
description: Your optics amplify light for twenty minutes.  Requires a cyber brain.

name: Fabricate: Print Ammo
description: Prints thirty rounds of 5.56 at your feet.  Requires a cyber brain.

name: Fabricate: Print Bandages
description: Prints three bandages at your feet.  Requires a cyber brain.

name: Phase: Blink
description: Teleports you up to eight tiles.  Requires a cyber brain.

name: Phase: Hop
description: A short, cheap teleport of three tiles.  Requires a cyber brain.

name: Drain: Siphon
description: Burns an enemy's circuits and takes some of the power back.  Requires a cyber brain.

name: Siphon gain
description: Returns power from a Siphon.

name: Reactive Shell
desc: A hard reactive skin covers you.

name: Afterimage
desc: Your outline lags behind your body.

name: Locked On
desc: Your aim is steady and tight.

name: Thermal Cloak
desc: Light and heat bend around you.

name: Dampened
desc: Your steps and shots are muffled.
